blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Maritime search and rescue requires locating people in the water quickly, motivating the use of UAVs to survey the search area. During flight, camera motion and the longer exposures used in low light can blur small targets and hinder person detection. Event cameras record brightness changes as they occur, reducing the motion blur associated with longer exposure times. We investigate their use for maritime person detection by generating synthetic events using the v2e event simulator from public MOBDrone rescue videos and retaining the existing annotations. We compare the recurrent vision transformer model RVT-T with YOLOv8n and RT-DETR-R18 trained on exposure-matched images. On 843 test samples from held-out recordings, RVT-T achieves 15.63% person AP50:95, compared with 6.89% for YOLOv8n and 9.44% for RT-DETR-R18 under 100 ms synthetic exposure. Increasing exposure times from 50 to 200 ms progressively reduces frame-based detection accuracy, widening the gap to the event model. To evaluate the feasibility of on-board processing, we deploy our detector on a Jetson Orin Nano platform. The RVT-T model retains its accuracy and requires approximately 136 ms and 2.02 J per sample, allowing real-time processing on the UAV.
blocks.zh: 海上搜索和救援要求迅速将人员放入水中,促使使用无人驾驶航空器来勘测搜索区域. 在飞行期间,相机运动和低光下使用的更长时间的暴露会模糊小目标并阻碍人探测. 事件相机记录亮度随发生而变化,减少与更长时间的曝光时间相关的运动模糊. 我们通过使用公共MOBDrone救援视频的v2e事件模拟器生成合成事件,并保留现有的说明,来调查它们用于海上人探测. 我们把反复出现的视觉变压器型号RVT-T与YOLOv8n和RT-DETR-R18进行了关于曝光相匹配图像的培训相提并论. 在843个来自被扣留录音的试验样本中,RVT-T达到15.63%的人AP50:95,而YOLOv8n为6.89%,RT-DETR-R18为9.44%,低于100毫秒的合成接触。 曝光时间从50至200米逐渐降低帧检测精度,与事件模型的差距也随之扩大. 为了评估机载处理的可行性,我们在杰特森·奥林·纳诺平台上部署探测器. RVT-T型机车保持了准确性,每台样机需要约136ms和2.02J,允许在无人机上实时处理.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Maritime search and rescue brings together the urgency of locating a person in distress and the difficulty of searching a large expanse of water.
Camera-equipped UAVs can support this task by providing an aerial view and helping rescue teams locate people who have fallen overboard [ 2 ] .
Their usefulness depends on both how quickly they can survey the search area and how reliably a person can be recognized in the captured observations.
Faster flight could shorten the time needed to cover a search area, making reliable detection during motion an important capability for aerial rescue systems.
blocks.zh:
海上搜索和救援使寻找遇难者的紧迫性和搜索大片水域的困难结合在一起。
摄像头设备 无人驾驶飞行器可以通过提供空中观察和帮助救援队找到坠落在飞机上的人来支援这项任务[2].
它们的有用性既取决于它们能够对搜索区域进行多快的勘测,也取决于在所捕获的观测中能够在多大程度上可靠地识别一个人.
更快的飞行可以缩短搜索区域所需的时间,使运动期间的可靠探测成为空中救援系统的重要能力.

blocks.en:
Maintaining reliable detection is difficult when people occupy only a few pixels against the water background.
Low illumination and rapid camera motion further challenge conventional imaging.
In low light, increasing exposure time collects more light, but also allows motion to spread a target’s appearance over more of the image, resulting in a blurred image [ 13 ] .
At a given exposure time, faster image motion likewise increases blur.
These effects connect the practical goals of searching in low light and flying faster to a common visual problem: preserving enough target detail for person detection.
blocks.zh:
当人们在水面上只占据少数像素时,就很难保持可靠的检测.
低照明和快速相机运动进一步挑战常规成像.
在低光线下,增加曝光时间能收集更多的光线,但也允许运动将目标外观传播到更多的图像上,导致图像模糊 [13].
在给定的曝光时间,更快的图像运动同样增加模糊度.
这些效果将低光搜索和飞得更快的实际目标与常见的视觉问题联系起来:为人检测保留足够的目标细节.

blocks.en:
Event cameras offer an alternative way to capture this detail.
Instead of accumulating a complete image over an exposure, they report brightness changes at individual pixels together with their timestamps [ 5 ] .
Their high temporal resolution reduces motion blur, while their wide dynamic range supports imaging across large brightness variations [ 5 ] .
Research on nighttime event imaging also demonstrates their potential for capturing motion in low-light scenes [ 13 ] .
For maritime search, these properties motivate an event-based view of the visibility challenges faced by aerial cameras, with the prospect of supporting faster search and operation under difficult illumination.
blocks.zh:
事件摄像头提供了另一种捕捉这一细节的方法.
与其在曝光时积累完整的图像,他们还报告单个像素的亮度变化以及时间戳[5].
它们的高时间分辨率降低了运动模糊度,而它们的宽动态范围则支持跨大亮度变化的成像[5].
对夜间事件成像的研究也显示了其在低光场景中捕捉运动的潜力[13].
就海上搜索而言,这些特性促使人们以事件为基础,看待航空摄像机面临的能见度挑战,并有望支持在困难的照明下加快搜索和作业。

blocks.en:
For onboard use, detection performance must be considered alongside computing and power requirements.
Prior maritime vision studies have examined how detector compression and hardware adaptation trade accuracy for inference efficiency [ 20 , 8 ] .
Bringing event-based vision into this setting calls for a corresponding understanding of its detection performance and embedded processing cost.
Evaluating both connects the promise of a different sensing approach to the hardware available on a search UAV.
blocks.zh:
就机上使用而言,检测性能必须同计算和动力要求一并考虑。
以往的海洋远景研究审查了探测器压缩和硬件适应贸易精度如何提高推断效率[20,8].
将基于事件的愿景带入这一设定要求对其检测性能和嵌入式处理成本有相应的理解.
评估两者将不同感知方法的希望与搜索无人机上可用的硬件联系起来。

blocks.en:
In this work, we explore event-based vision as a sensing approach for person detection in maritime UAV search.
Public MOBDrone rescue footage and its existing annotations provide a common basis for evaluating event-based and frame-based person detection [ 2 ] .
Using simulated events derived from this footage, we study detection under exposure blur (Fig. 1 ) and assess the onboard processing requirements through measurements on an Orin Nano.
The study connects an application-level motivation for event cameras with detection evidence and practical deployment considerations.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们探索以事件为基础的愿景,作为海上无人驾驶航空器搜索中探测人的感知方法。
公共MOBDrone救援镜头及其现有说明为评价基于事件和帧的个人检测提供了共同的基础[2].
利用这些镜头产生的模拟事件,我们研究暴露模糊的探测(图1),并通过对Orin Nano的测量评估船上的处理要求。
该研究将事件摄像头的应用级动机与探测证据和实际部署考虑联系起来.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We establish a reproducible MOBDrone-derived evaluation protocol that pairs simulated events and exposure-integrated images while preserving source separation and annotation times. • We characterize the person-detection benefit of an event-based system under synthetic exposure blur, including its sensitivity to exposure duration and its associated false positives. • We measure the trained detectors’ accuracy, latency, and energy consumption on a Jetson Orin Nano to characterize the tradeoff between person-detection performance and onboard processing cost.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们建立了可复制的MOBDrone派生评价协议,将模拟事件和曝光综合图像配对,同时保留源分离和注释时间。 我们把基于事件的系统在合成暴露下的个人探测好处描述为模糊不清,包括其对暴露期的敏感性及其相关的假阳性。 我们用Jetson Orin Nano测量训练有素的探测器的准确性、耐久性和能耗,以说明人员探测性能与机载处理成本之间的权衡。

blocks.en: We establish a reproducible MOBDrone-derived evaluation protocol that pairs simulated events and exposure-integrated images while preserving source separation and annotation times.
blocks.zh: 我们建立了可复制的MOBDrone衍生评价协议,将模拟事件和曝光综合图像配对,同时保留源分离和注释时间.

blocks.en: We characterize the person-detection benefit of an event-based system under synthetic exposure blur, including its sensitivity to exposure duration and its associated false positives.
blocks.zh: 我们将基于事件的系统在合成暴露下的个人探测惠益描述为模糊不清,包括其对暴露期的敏感性及其相关的假阳性。

blocks.en: We measure the trained detectors’ accuracy, latency, and energy consumption on a Jetson Orin Nano to characterize the tradeoff between person-detection performance and onboard processing cost.
blocks.zh: 我们用Jetson Orin Nano测量训练有素的探测器的准确性、耐久性和能耗,以说明人员探测性能与机载处理成本之间的权衡。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Event-based vision
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于事件的设想

blocks.en:
Event-based vision offers an alternative way to observe moving objects under challenging imaging conditions.
An event camera records brightness changes independently at each pixel, reporting their timing rather than collecting a complete image over a shared exposure [ 5 ] .
Its high temporal resolution helps preserve motion detail, while its wide dynamic range accommodates large differences in scene brightness [ 5 ] .
These properties are relevant to maritime monitoring from moving UAVs, where small targets must be distinguished against water backgrounds with changing illumination and reflections.
blocks.zh:
基于事件的视觉为在具有挑战性的成像条件下观察移动物体提供了另一种方式。
一个事件相机记录每个像素的亮度独立变化,报告它们的时间,而不是通过共享曝光来收集完整的图像[5].
其高时间分辨率有助于保存运动细节,而其广泛的动态范围能容纳场景亮度的巨大差异[5].
这些特性与移动无人驾驶飞行器的海上监测有关,在移动无人驾驶飞行器时,必须区分小目标与水背景以及不断变化的照明和反射。

blocks.en:
Simulators make event data available for exploring such applications using rendered scenes or existing videos, partially compensating for the limited availability of annotated event data.
ESIM generates events through adaptive scene rendering [ 19 ] , while video-to-event methods allow annotated video datasets to be reused for event-based learning [ 6 ] .
The v2e toolbox converts video frames into events with models of sensor response and noise [ 9 ] .
This provides a practical route for maritime researchers to build on existing footage and object annotations.
Studies of synthetic-to-real learning further demonstrate transfer to real events for object recognition and semantic segmentation [ 6 ] , with DA4Event improving transfer for recognition through domain adaptation [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh:
模拟器利用制作的场景或现有视频提供事件数据,以探索此类应用,部分补偿附加说明的事件数据有限。
ESIM通过适应性的场景渲染生成事件[19],而视频对事件的方法则允许附加注释的视频数据集被重新用于基于事件的学习[6].
v2e工具箱将视频帧转换为带有感应和噪音模型的事件[9].
这为海事研究者在现有镜头和物体说明的基础上提供了一条实用的路线.
对合成-现实学习的研究进一步证明,通过DA4Event改进了通过域适应进行识别的转让[18],向实际事件转移以进行对象识别和语义分割[6].

blocks.en:
Event-based object detection has already produced successful examples in automotive perception.
The Gen1 and 1 Megapixel (1Mpx) benchmarks provide large-scale recordings with annotations for road users, supporting the development and comparison of learned detectors [ 4 , 17 ] .
The Recurrent Event-camera Detector (RED) uses memory to combine information over time and achieves detection performance comparable to frame-based models on 1Mpx [ 17 ] .
Recurrent Vision Transformers (RVT) combine spatial attention with temporal memory to improve the balance between detection accuracy and processing time [ 7 ] .
Later work addresses practical requirements: SAST reduces computation by selecting informative regions, while LEOD makes better use of limited annotations through self-training [ 16 , 23 ] .
Together, these data-generation tools and established detectors provide a starting point for bringing event-based vision to maritime monitoring.
We build on v2e and the Tiny variant of RVT (RVT-T) [ 7 ] to investigate person detection in aerial rescue footage and its embedded processing requirements.
blocks.zh:
基于事件的对象检测已经产生了汽车感知的成功例子.
Gen1和1Megapixel(1Mpx)基准提供了大型录音,并附有道路使用者的说明,支持开发并比较学到的探测器[4,17].
经常性事件-相机探测器(RED)使用内存将信息随时间推移合并,并在1Mpx [17]上实现与帧模型相当的检测性能.
经常性视野变换器(RVT)将空间注意力和时间内存结合起来,改善探测精度与处理时间之间的平衡[7].
后来的工作涉及实际要求: SAST通过选择信息区减少计算,而LEOD则通过自我训练更好地利用有限的说明[16,23].
这些数据生成工具和既有探测器共同为海洋监测带来了基于事件的愿景提供了一个起点。
我们利用v2e和RVT(RVT-T)的Tiny变体[7]来调查空中救援镜头中的人探测及其嵌入式处理要求.

blocks.en: 2.2 Maritime object detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 海上物体探测

blocks.en:
Public aerial datasets support the development of visual detection for maritime search and rescue.
MOBDrone provides drone footage with annotations for people in the water and other maritime objects [ 2 ] .
On SeaDronesSee [ 21 ] , YOLOv7-Sea adapts a frame-based detector to maritime UAV imagery through an additional small-object prediction head and an attention module [ 24 ] .
LCSC-UAVNet likewise studies lightweight small-object detection from a maritime UAV perspective [ 22 ] .
These studies connect detector design to the target scales and image content encountered in aerial maritime observation.
blocks.zh:
公共航空数据集支持海上搜救的视觉探测发展.
MOBDrone提供无人机镜头,为水中人员和其他海洋物体提供说明[2].
SeaDrones见[21],YOLOv7-Sea通过一个额外的小物体预测头和一个注意舱[24],使一个帧式探测器适应海上无人机图像.
LCSC-UAVNet同样从海上无人驾驶航空器的角度研究轻量级小物体探测[22].
这些研究将探测器设计与空中海洋观测中遇到的目标尺度和图像内容联系起来。

blocks.en:
Event-based perception has also been explored for marine objects.
Aelmore et al. [ 1 ] combine event filtering, clustering, and motion analysis for vessel detection and tracking.
Marine Event Vision uses event-based generalized Hough-transform template matching and clustering to detect objects on the water surface and underwater [ 3 ] .
These applications motivate further exploration of event sensing for maritime vision.
Our study focuses on aerial person detection and examines how exposure blur affects the comparison between event-based and frame-based systems.
blocks.zh:
对海洋物体也探索了基于事件的看法。
Aelmore等人著. [1] 结合事件过滤,集群,运动分析,用于船舶检测和跟踪.
Marine Evention Vision使用基于事件的通用Hough-transform模板匹配和集群来检测水面和水下物体[3].
这些应用促使人们进一步探索海洋视觉事件感知。
我们的研究侧重于空中人员探测,并研究暴露如何模糊影响基于事件和帧系统的比较。

blocks.en: 2.3 Embedded maritime vision
blocks.zh: 2.3 国家 嵌入式海洋远景

blocks.en:
Embedded evaluations connect maritime perception algorithms to the computing resources available on their platforms.
Heller et al. [ 8 ] study YOLO-based marine object detection and its optimization for several edge devices.
Rizk et al. [ 20 ] examine pruning and quantization for human detection in marine environments.
For fluvial navigation, Lambert et al. [ 11 ] compare segmentation networks and evaluate their performance on a Jetson Nano, relating scene understanding to inference speed on embedded hardware.
Together, these studies motivate evaluating visual accuracy alongside actual device performance.
We apply this perspective to event-based aerial person detection by measuring the trained models’ accuracy, latency, and energy on an Orin Nano.
blocks.zh:
嵌入式评价将海洋感知算法与其平台上可用的计算资源联系起来.
Heller 等人著. [8]研究基于YOLO的海洋物体探测及其对多个边缘装置的优化.
Rizk 等 (英语). [20] 检查排查和量化,以便人类在海洋环境中检测。
对于流体导航,Lambert et al. [11] 比较分区网络,并评价其在Jetson Nano上的性能,将场景理解与嵌入式硬件上的推论速度联系起来.
这些研究加在一起,促使评价视觉准确性与实际设备性能。
我们用这一视角来测量训练有素的模型在奥林纳诺上的准确度、耐久度和能量。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Event Data
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 事件数据

blocks.en:
An event stream is a sequence of brightness-change measurements, each represented as e = ( x , y , τ , p ) e=(x,y,\tau,p) [ 5 ] .
The coordinates ( x , y ) (x,y) locate the responding pixel, τ \tau records the time of the change, and the polarity p p indicates whether brightness increased or decreased.
Each pixel triggers an event when its log intensity changes by a contrast threshold relative to its stored reference [ 5 ] .
The reference is updated after each event, allowing the pixel to report subsequent changes independently.
Positive (ON) and negative (OFF) events describe increases and decreases in brightness, respectively.
As a person’s boundary moves across the image, successive pixels respond to the contrast between the person and the surrounding water.
UAV motion can produce this response even for a stationary target, while waves and changing reflections generate additional events in the background.
Together, these measurements describe where and when changes occur as the camera and objects move.
blocks.zh:
事件流是亮度变化测量的序列,每个表示为e=(x,y, \,p) e=(x,y,\tau,p) [5].
坐标 (x, y) (x, y) 定位响应像素,\\ tau 记录变化的时间, 极性 p 表示亮度是否增加或减少 。
每个像素会触发一个事件,当它的日志强度通过相对于其存储的引用的对比阈值变化[5].
引用在每次事件后都会更新,使像素能够独立地报告后续的变化.
正(ON)和负(OFF)事件分别描述了亮度的增减.
当一个人的边界跨过图像时,连续的像素会响应人与周围水的对比.
无人机运动甚至对固定目标也能产生这种响应,而波浪和不断变化的反射则在背景中产生额外的事件.
这些测量方法共同描述了随着相机和物体移动而发生变化的地点和时间.

blocks.en:
Our red-and-blue event views accumulate these measurements over a short time window: red indicates positive events, blue indicates negative events, and white indicates no events; dark pixels indicate overlapping positive and negative activity.
To use this information for detection, we collect events over a recent time interval and organize them into spatial maps of event counts, separated by time and polarity.
blocks.zh:
我们的红蓝事件视图通过一个短暂的窗口来积累这些测量:红色表示正事件,蓝色表示负事件,白色表示无事件;暗像素表示重叠的正和负活动.
为了利用这一信息进行探测,我们收集了最近一个时间间隔内的事件,并将其组织成事件计数的空间地图,以时间和极性分隔.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集

blocks.en:
We use MOBDrone because it provides continuous aerial rescue footage and existing object annotations, supporting both video-to-event conversion and exposure formation from the same scenes [ 2 ] .
The dataset contains 66 video fragments with a native resolution of 1920 × 1012 1920\times 1012 .
We retain all five annotated categories: person, boat, surfboard, wood, and lifebuoy, with person detection as the primary application task.
The person category includes people in the water and on boats or boards.
To evaluate generalization across recordings, we assign original video identities to disjoint training, validation, and test sets, keeping all fragments and observation variants from each source together.
We define a sample as one annotated time together with its corresponding frame observation or event history and object labels.
Sampling every 15th source frame (approximately every 0.5 s at approximately 29.97 frames/s) gives 5,839 training, 1,691 validation, and 843 test samples.
The test set contains five original sources videos and 835 person instances.
We retain its 392 samples without annotated persons to assess false positives alongside person detection.
blocks.zh:
我们使用MOBDrone,因为它提供持续的空中救援镜头和现有的物体说明,支持视频对事件转换和来自同一场景的曝光形成[2].
数据集包含66个视频片段,原生分辨率为1920×1012 1920\times 1012 .
我们保留了所有五个附加说明的类别:人、船、冲浪板、木头和生命体,主要应用任务是人检测。
人员类别包括水上和船上或船上的人员。
为了评价各种录音的通用性,我们指定了原有的视频身份来进行脱节训练、验证和测试,将每个来源的所有碎片和观测变体放在一起。
我们把样本定义为一个附加注释的时间,以及相应的帧观测或事件历史和对象标签.
每15个源框取样(约每0.5秒,约29.97帧/秒),可提供5 839个培训、1 691个验证和843个测试样本。
测试集包含5个原始源视频和835人例.
我们保留了392个样本,没有附带说明的人来评估假阳性,同时进行人员检测。

blocks.en:
The small size of people in the aerial view motivates evaluating localization at the original image resolution.
Of the test person boxes, 419 fall within the COCO small-object area range [ 12 ] .
Figure 2 illustrates the target scale in a complete search image: the selected person occupies a 23.3 × 25.8 23.3\times 25.8 -pixel annotation box against the surrounding water.
blocks.zh:
空中视野中的人规模小,促使人们以原始图像分辨率评价本地化.
在试验人盒中,419个属于COCO小物体范围[12].
图2用完整的搜索图像来说明目标尺度:被选中的人占据了23.3×25.8 23.3\times 25.8 - 像素注解框对周围的水.

blocks.en: 3.3 Data Preparation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 数据编制

blocks.en:
To compare sensing alternatives on the same search scenes, we construct frame observations and event histories at the same annotation times.
Decoded video timestamps align the observations with the original labels.
We scale both spatial coordinates by 1 / 3 1/3 and add black padding at the bottom to obtain a 640 × 640 640\times 640 input canvas.
This transformation gives the models a common input geometry while preserving the correspondence with native-coordinate boxes.
Frames use bilinear affine resampling, which at this exact scale samples every third native pixel without antialiasing.
Event counts are summed over 3 × 3 3\times 3 native-pixel cells.
At this scale, the example person in Fig. 2 occupies approximately 7.8 × 8.6 7.8\times 8.6 pixels.
blocks.zh:
为了比较同一搜索场景的感知替代方法,我们在同一个注释时间构建帧观测和事件历史.
解码视频时间戳将观测结果与原标签一致.
我们用1 / 3 1/ 3 的空间坐标缩放,并在底部增加黑色的垫板,以获得一个 640 × 640 640\时的 640 输入画布.
这种变换使模型在保留与本土坐标框的对应性的同时具有了共同的输入几何.
Frames使用双线性affine再生标本,在这个精确的尺度上,每三分之一的原生像素样本没有抗异名.
事件计数在 3× 3 3\ 次 3 个本地像素单元格中进行汇总 。
在这个尺度上,图2中的例子人物占地约7.8×8.6\时8.6像素.

blocks.en:
We use original frames as the reference condition and construct reduced-brightness and exposure-integrated observations to examine the effects of brightness and motion accumulation.
The reduced-brightness condition multiplies encoded pixel values by 0.25, rounds to the nearest integer, and stores the result as an 8-bit image.
To study motion during exposure, we integrate linearized RGB radiance L ⁡ ( s ) L(s) over an interval of duration T T ending at annotation time t t : B t = Γ ⁡ ( 1 T ​ ∫ t − T t L ⁡ ( s ) ​ 𝑑 s ) , B_{t}=\Gamma\left(\frac{1}{T}\int_{t-T}^{t}L(s)\,ds\right), (1) where Γ \Gamma converts the integrated radiance back to encoded RGB.
We approximate the integral by piecewise-linear interpolation between decoded video timestamps, using observations up to t t .
The label describes the person’s position at the end of the interval, giving the detector the task of localizing the current position from the accumulated appearance.
We chose 100 ms as the primary exposure after inspecting training examples for visible person blur and interpretable boxes.
Additional 50 and 200 ms conditions examine how the comparison changes with integration duration.
blocks.zh:
我们使用原始框架作为参考条件,并构建减光光度和曝光综合观测,以检查亮度和运动积累的影响.
减速-亮度条件将编码的像素值乘以0.25,回合到最近的整数,并将结果存储为8位图像.
为了研究接触时的运动,我们在一段时间内将线性化的RGB光度L →(s) L(s) 集成 T T 结束于注解时间 t : B t = → (1 T → → − T → (s) d s ) , B_{t}=\Gamma\left(\frac{1}T}\int_{t-T}^{t}L(s)\,ds\right),(1) 其中\Gamma将集成的光线转换回编码的RGB.
我们通过解码的视频时间戳之间的片断线插值来估计构件,使用最高为 t t 的观测数据。
标签描述人物在间隔末端的位置,赋予探测器从累积外观中定位当前位置的任务.
在检查了可见人物模糊和可解释的盒子的培训实例后,我们选择了100毫秒作为主要接触.
额外50和200毫秒的条件审查比较与融合期有何变化。

blocks.en:
To provide an event-based observation of the same scenes, we apply v2e to the original video at its source cadence [ 9 ] .
The simulator generates an event when the change in log intensity at a pixel reaches its contrast threshold.
We use a threshold of 0.2 with threshold variability of 0.03, an unlimited photoreceptor bandwidth, and disabled shot, leak, and photoreceptor noise.
For the reduced-brightness condition, we regenerate events from the brightness-scaled video.
For the exposure comparisons, events from the original video provide a shared reference, and the corresponding RVT-T entries reuse the same predictions across integration durations.
blocks.zh:
为了对同一场景进行基于事件的观察,我们将v2e应用到原视频的源头cadence[9].
模拟器在像素的日志强度变化达到其对比阈值时生成一个事件.
我们使用0.2的阈值,阈值可变性为0.03,无限制的光受体带宽,以及阻断镜头,泄漏,和光受体噪音.
对于减速-亮度条件,我们从亮度尺度的视频中再现事件.
对于曝光比较,原始视频中的事件提供了一个共享的参考,相应的RVT-T条目在整个集成期间重复同样的预测.

blocks.en:
For each sample, we collect the 200 ms of events leading up to its annotation time and divide this history into four consecutive 50 ms windows.
Within each window, we count events at each spatial location in ten equal 5 ms time bins, keeping positive and negative polarities separate.
Each bin therefore contributes two spatial maps: one for increases in brightness and one for decreases.
Stacking these maps gives twenty channels on the common 640 × 640 640\times 640 canvas for each window.
The resulting sample contains a sequence of four twenty-channel representations, preserving both the locations of brightness changes and their order over time.
For visualization, we sum the time bins of the final 50 ms window and display positive counts in red and negative counts in blue.
The detector processes the full sequence of four representations.
blocks.zh:
对于每一个样本,我们收集了200 ms事件 导致它的注解时间 并把这个历史 分为四个连续50 ms窗口。
在每个窗口中,我们将每个空间位置上的事件数成10个等于5 ms的时间箱,使正极和负极性分开.
因此,每个垃圾桶都提供两个空间图:一个用于增加亮度,另一个用于减少亮度。
堆叠这些地图可以给常见的640×640 640\times 640画布上20个通道,每个窗口.
由此产生的样本包含四个二十道表达的序列,既保留亮度变化的地点,也保留其随时间推移的顺序.
为了可视化,我们将最后的50ms窗口的时间箱进行总和,并以红色和蓝色的负数显示正数.
探测器处理四个表示的全部序列.

blocks.en: 3.4 Detection Models
blocks.zh: 3.4 检测模型

blocks.en:
We use RVT-T to process the four event representations in chronological order [ 7 ] .
The recurrent vision transformer extracts spatial features from each representation and passes an internal memory state to the next step, combining information across the 200 ms history.
We initialize this state at the start of each sample and use the final step’s detections to localize objects at the annotation time.
blocks.zh:
我们用RVT-T按时间顺序处理四个事件表述[7].
经常性的视变器从每个代表物中提取空间特征,并将一个内存状态传递到下一步,将200ms历史中的信息综合起来.
我们在每个样本开始时初始化此状态,并使用最后步骤的检测在注释时将物体定位.

blocks.en:
YOLOv8n provides a compact frame-based baseline [ 10 ] , and RT-DETR-R18 provides a transformer-based frame comparison [ 25 ] .
Each receives one image in the corresponding observation condition and predicts boxes for the same five categories.
The comparison therefore evaluates complete observation-and-detector systems: temporally binned event histories and individual original, brightness-scaled, or exposure-integrated frames.
At 200 ms exposure, frame integration spans the same interval duration as the RVT-T history.
blocks.zh:
YOLOv8n提供了一个紧凑的基于帧的基准[10],RT-DETR-R18提供了一个基于变压器的帧比较[25].
每个都得到相应的观测条件中的一个图像,并预测相同五个类别的框.
因此,该比较评价了完整的观测和检测系统:暂时性地将事件历史和单个原创、亮度尺度或暴露综合框架。
在200ms曝光时,帧集成的时间跨度与RVT-T历史相同.

blocks.en:
Table 1: Person detection results on held-out source videos, in percent. Best values are bold within each condition and metric.
The 100 ms RVT-T row reuses the original-condition event model and predictions; only the frame inputs change with exposure.
Recall uses confidence 0.25 and matching IoU 0.5; AP S denotes person AP for small objects.
blocks.zh:
表1:被搁置的源视频的人检测结果,百分比。 每个条件和度量中,最佳值都是粗体的。
100ms RVT-T列重用原条件事件模型和预测;只有帧输入随着曝光而改变.
召回使用信任0.25并匹配IoU 0.5;AP S表示小型物体的人AP.

blocks.en: 3.5 Training and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.5 培训和评价议定书

blocks.en:
To measure adaptation to each observation condition, we train each frame detector on the image condition used for its evaluation.
All three model families train from scratch on the same recording-level split, with batch size 16, a single training seed, and image augmentation disabled.
Training uses AdamW [ 14 ] with cosine learning-rate schedules and runs for approximately 30–90 epochs, with fixed budgets for RVT-T and RT-DETR-R18 and early stopping for YOLOv8n.
Checkpoints are selected using validation performance: five-class AP 50:95 for RVT-T and RT-DETR-R18, and YOLOv8n’s combined AP 50 and AP 50:95 fitness.
YOLOv8n uses its built-in training validator for checkpoint selection; the final comparison evaluates every selected model on the common 640 × 640 640\times 640 inputs with the same COCO scoring procedure.
RVT-T and YOLOv8n apply non-maximum suppression, while RT-DETR-R18 uses its native postprocessor.
The main detection experiments use FP32 inference.
blocks.zh:
为了衡量每个观测条件的适应性,我们根据用于评估的图像条件培训每个帧探测器。
所有三个模范家庭都从零开始在同一录制级别分拆上进行训练,分批大小为16,单一训练种子,图像增强功能被禁用.
训练使用 AdamW [14] 的余弦学习率表,运行时间大约为30–90个历程,RVT-T和RT-DETR-R18的固定预算,YOLOv8n的早停.
使用验证性能选择检查点:为RVT-T和RT-DETR-R18的五级AP50:95,为YOLOv8n的AP50和AP50:95综合健身.
YOLOv8n使用其内置的训练验证器进行检查站选择;最终比较评价了通用640×640 640\times 640输入器上每个选用的模型,采用相同的COCO评分程序.
RVT-T和YOLOv8n应用非最大抑制,而RT-DETR-R18则使用其本土的后处理器.
主要探测实验使用FP32推论.

blocks.en:
We evaluate person detection for the rescue task, using person AP 50:95 as the primary measure of localization and detection quality.
We also report person AP 50 , precision, recall, and AP S .
All predictions are transformed back to native image coordinates and clipped before evaluation with the same COCO scoring procedure.
Person AP S is AP 50:95 for small objects under COCO’s native-coordinate area convention; its 32 × 32 32\times 32 -pixel area threshold corresponds to roughly 11 × 11 11\times 11 pixels in square-equivalent area after input scaling.
blocks.zh:
我们以AP50:95作为本地化和检测质量的主要衡量标准,评估救援任务的人员检测。
我们还报告个人AP50,精确度,回忆度,APS.
所有预测都转换为原生图像坐标,并在采用相同的COCO评分程序进行评估前进行剪切.
个人AP S是 AP 50:95 对于COCO 的本土坐标区域公约下的小物体;它的32×3232\times 32-像素区域阈值在输入缩放后大约相当于11×1111\times 11像素的平方形区域.

blocks.en:
Precision and recall use confidence 0.25 and matching IoU 0.5 throughout.
These rates describe each detector at the specified numerical threshold, with its own confidence-score distribution.
We further evaluate the trained models on an Orin Nano using the deployment and measurement protocol in Section 5 .
blocks.zh:
精确度和召回度使用0.25的置信度,全过程匹配IoU 0.5.
这些速率说明每个探测器在规定的数值阈值上,并有其自身的置信分分布.
我们利用第5节的部署和测量规程,进一步评估奥林纳诺训练有素的模型。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
We first examine person detection across observation conditions, then study exposure duration and the distribution of detections and false positives across the test scenes.
Table 1 reports results for the original, reduced-brightness, and 100 ms exposure conditions.
blocks.zh:
我们首先检查人们在观测条件下的检测,然后研究曝光时间和检测结果和假阳性在测试场景中的分布.
表1报告了最初的、减少的和100毫秒的接触条件。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : Test person AP 50:95 (%) as exposure is prolonged from the original video.
Solid curves show exposure-matched frame models; the dashed line shows the same RVT-T predictions reused across exposure conditions.
blocks.zh:
图3:测试人AP50:95(%),因为接触时间从原始视频延长。
固体曲线显示的是曝光匹配的框架模型;破折线显示的是相同的RVT-T预测,在曝光条件下重复使用.

blocks.en: 4.1 Person Detection across Observation Conditions
blocks.zh: 4.1 跨观察条件的人员检测

blocks.en: On the original observations, RVT-T and RT-DETR-R18 achieve nearly identical person AP 50:95 , at 15.63% and 15.64%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在最初的观察中,RVT-T和RT-DETR-R18分别以15.63%和15.64%的成绩实现了几乎相同的人AP50:95.

blocks.en:
The comparison changes under 100 ms exposure: RVT-T reaches 15.63%, while the exposure-matched YOLOv8n and RT-DETR-R18 models reach 6.89% and 9.44%.
The event system therefore leads RT-DETR-R18 by 6.19 percentage points in this condition.
Person AP 50 is 37.42% for RVT-T, 21.42% for YOLOv8n, and 28.64% for RT-DETR-R18, retaining the same ordering.
RVT-T’s person AP S is also higher, at 4.59% compared with 0.67% for YOLOv8n and 2.36% for RT-DETR-R18.
These small-target results are especially relevant to aerial rescue imagery, where a person occupies only a small part of the search scene.
blocks.zh:
比较变化在100毫秒的接触下:RVT-T达到15.63%,而接触匹配的YOLOv8n和RT-DETR-R18模型达到6.89%和9.44%.
因此,事件系统导致RT-DETR-R18在此条件下以6.19个百分点领先.
AP50为RVT-T37.42%,YOLOv8n为21.42%,RT-DETR-R18为28.64%,保留相同的订单.
RVT-T的人AP S也更高,为4.59%,而YOLOv8n为0.67%,RT-DETR-R18为2.36%。
这些小目标结果与空中救援图像特别相关,因为一个人只占据了搜索现场的一小部分.

blocks.en:
Under reduced brightness, RT-DETR-R18 leads in person AP 50:95 , at 15.29% compared with 13.65% for RVT-T and 11.08% for YOLOv8n.
The clearest event-based benefit in this evaluation is thus person detection in exposure-blurred observations.
blocks.zh:
在亮度降低的情况下,RT-DETR-R18领先于个人AP50:95,为15.29%,而RVT-T为13.65%,YOLOv8n为11.08%.
因此,本次评估中最明确的基于事件的好处是在暴露模糊的观测中发现人。

blocks.en: 4.2 Exposure Duration
blocks.zh: 4.2 接触时间

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : Paired person-detection examples from three test recordings, with the same crop across each row.
(a) RVT-T detects the person missed by both frame models.
(b) RVT-T misses the person detected by RT-DETR-R18 amid strong water-background events.
(c) All three models detect the person.
Green boxes show ground truth; dashed orange boxes and scores show predictions at confidence ≥ 0.25 \geq 0.25 .
Frame predictions use 100 ms exposure images.
Event views show the final 50 ms, with red/blue for increasing/decreasing brightness, dark for overlapping polarities, and white for no events; RVT-T uses the full 200 ms history.
blocks.zh:
图4:Paired person-detection example from three test records,每行相同作物.
(a) RVT-T探测到两个帧模型都漏掉的人。
(b) RVT-T错过了RT-DETR-R18在强烈的水底事件中探测到的人。
(c) 所有三种型号都检测到此人。
绿色盒子显示地面真相;破碎的橙色盒子和分数显示置信度为0.25\geq0.25。
框架预测使用100ms曝光图像.
事件视图显示最后50ms,红色/蓝色用于增/减亮,黑暗用于重叠极性,白色用于无事件;RVT-T使用完整的200ms历史.

blocks.en:
Longer exposure progressively reduces person AP 50:95 for both frame detectors (Fig. 3 ).
Across 50, 100, and 200 ms, RT-DETR-R18 achieves 14.30%, 9.44%, and 4.81%, while YOLOv8n achieves 8.93%, 6.89%, and 3.85%.
Each frame model is trained for its corresponding exposure condition.
Against the shared source-cadence RVT-T reference of 15.63%, the gap to RT-DETR-R18 grows from 1.33 to 10.82 percentage points.
As integration duration increases, the frame combines a longer history of target appearances while the annotation identifies the person’s position at the end of that interval.
blocks.zh:
对两个框架探测器而言,较长的接触逐渐减少人AP50:95(图3)。
在50、100和200米之间,RT-DETR-R18实现了14.30%、9.44%和4.81%,而YOLOv8n实现了8.93%、6.89%和3.85%。
每个框架模型都接受了相应的暴露条件培训。
与15.63%的共享源码RVT-T参考相比,RT-DETR-R18的差距从1.33个百分点增加到10.82个百分点.
随着集成期的延长,框架结合了目标外观的较长历史,而注释则确定了人物在该间隔结束时的位置.

blocks.en: Table 2: Person precision and recall (%) for the 100 ms comparison.
blocks.zh: 表2:比较100 ms的精确度和召回率(%)。

blocks.en: Table 3: Detection accuracy and FP16 processing cost on Jetson Orin Nano.
blocks.zh: 表3:Jetson Orin Nano的检测精度和FP16处理成本。

blocks.en: 4.3 Scene Variation and False Positives
blocks.zh: 4.3 场面变异和假阳性

blocks.en:
The 100 ms comparison varies substantially across the five test recordings, with all three systems obtaining near-zero person AP 50:95 on one recording.
RVT-T leads both frame models on the other four recordings, and its pooled person AP 50:95 remains higher after omitting any one recording.
blocks.zh:
100 ms的比较在5个测试录制中差别很大,所有3个系统在一次录制上都获得了近0人AP50:95.
RVT-T在另外四部录音中都领先两个帧模型,其集合人物AP50:95在省略任何一部录音后仍然较高.

blocks.en:
At confidence 0.25 and matching IoU 0.5, RVT-T has person recall of 37.25%, compared with 22.16% for YOLOv8n and 30.42% for RT-DETR-R18 (Table 2 ).
Relative to YOLOv8n, this higher recall accompanies slightly lower precision, 48.67% versus 51.10%.
RT-DETR-R18 has precision of 31.47% at this operating point.
Higher recall means that more annotated people are detected, while lower precision means that a larger fraction of candidate detections are false positives. For rescue teams, the gain in person detection therefore comes with additional false detections to review.
blocks.zh:
在0.25和匹配的IoU 0.5中,RVT-T的人员召回率为37.25%,而YOLOv8n为22.16%,RT-DETR-R18为30.42%(表2)。
相对于YOLOv8n,这种较高的召回附带的精度略低,48.67%对51.10%.
RT-DETR-R18在此操作点的精度为31.47%.
较高的召回表示检测到更多注解的人,而较低的精度则表示考生检测到的较大比例是虚假的阳性. 因此,对于救援队来说,个人发现的好处是需要审查更多的虚假发现。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 illustrates the visual conditions behind the comparison.
In the first row, the person’s appearance is spread by exposure integration, while the event representation contains a compact response and RVT-T detects the target.
In the second row, water activity produces a strong event background and RVT-T misses a person detected by RT-DETR-R18.
All three models detect the person in the third row.
Together, these examples show the value of retaining target detail during motion and the continuing importance of separating a small person from the surrounding water.
blocks.zh:
图4说明了比较的视觉条件。
在第一行中,人物的外观通过曝光集成来传播,而事件表现包含紧凑的响应,RVT-T检测到目标.
在第二行中,水活动产生强烈的事件背景,RVT-T想念RT-DETR-R18检测到的人.
三个模型都检测到第三排的人.
这些例子表明,在运动过程中保留目标细节的价值以及将一个小人物与周围水分开的持续重要性。

blocks.en: 5 Embedded Deployment
blocks.zh: 5 嵌入式部署

blocks.en:
The detection benefit under exposure blur motivates examining the computing resources needed to use the event model onboard a search UAV.
We deploy source-cadence RVT-T and the two 100 ms-trained frame models on a Jetson Orin Nano and compare their accuracy, latency, and energy per sample.
blocks.zh:
暴露下的检测惠益模糊了对使用无人机上的事件模型所需计算资源的审查。
我们在Jetson Orin Nano上安装了源码RVT-T和两个100毫秒训练的帧模型,并比较每个样本的准确性,耐久性和能量.

blocks.en: 5.1 Deployment and Measurement
blocks.zh: 5.1 部署和计量

blocks.en:
All models use batch-one PyTorch CUDA inference on the same device in MAXN_SUPER mode with locked CPU, GPU, and memory clocks.
FP32 and FP16 accuracy are evaluated on all 843 test samples.
Latency and energy measurements use a shared set of 16 test samples held in RAM and sampled across the test set.
After warmup, each measurement runs for at least 1,000 sample evaluations and 60 seconds.
We repeat the measurements three times and rotate model order between repetitions.
blocks.zh:
在MAXN_中,所有型号都使用批次1 PyTorch CUDA推论对同一设备进行推论. 带有锁定的CPU,GPU和内存时钟的SUPER模式.
所有843个测试样本都评估了FP32和FP16的准确性。
延迟和能量测量使用一套共用的16个测试样本,在记录和档案管理中保存,并在整个测试中取样。
热身后,每次测量至少进行1000次抽样评价,60秒.
我们重复三次测量,在重复之间旋转模型顺序.

blocks.en:
The measured pipeline begins with prepared event histories or resized images in memory and ends with detections in native image coordinates, including CPU-to-GPU transfer, dtype conversion, model inference, and postprocessing.
Each RVT-T sample transfers its full 200 ms history, resets the recurrent state, and processes all four 50 ms windows.
Input preparation, acquisition, and disk access lie outside this timing interval.
We integrate module-input power over each run and divide by the number of processed samples to obtain energy per sample, including idle consumption.
Table 3 reports the range across the three FP16 repetitions for median (p50) and 95th-percentile (p95) latency, mean module-input power, and energy.
blocks.zh:
测量到的管道开始于已准备的事件历史或内存中的图像大小调整,结束于本土图像坐标的检测,包括CPU到GPU的传输,dtype转换,模型推论,以及后处理.
每一个RVT-T样本转移其完整的200ms历史,重置反复状态,并处理所有四个50ms窗口.
输入准备、获取和磁盘访问都在这个时间间隔之外。
我们把每个运行的模块输入功率综合起来,除以每个样本的加工样品数量,以获得能量,包括闲置消耗。
表3报告了三次FP16重复中位数(p50)和95-百分率(p95)的间隔、平均模块输入功率和能量的幅度。

blocks.en: 5.2 Accuracy and Processing Cost
blocks.zh: 5.2 准确性和处理费用

blocks.en:
FP16 preserves person AP 50:95 to within 0.14 percentage points of FP32 for all three models.
The deployed RVT-T therefore retains its detection advantage in the 100 ms comparison, with person AP 50:95 of 15.63% versus 6.75% for YOLOv8n and 9.50% for RT-DETR-R18.
The higher person detection performance comes with a higher processing cost: RVT-T requires approximately 136 ms and 2.02 J per sample, compared with 21 ms and 0.23 J for YOLOv8n and 59 ms and 0.77 J for RT-DETR-R18.
blocks.zh:
FP16将所有三种型号的人AP50:95保留到FP32的0.14个百分点以内.
因此,部署的RVT-T在100 ms的比较中保留了其检测优势,人AP50:95,YOLOv8n为15.63%,而YOLOv8n为6.75%,RT-DETR-R18为9.50%。
较高的人检测性能伴随着较高的处理成本:RVT-T每样大约需要136毫秒和2.02焦耳,而YOLOv8n的则需要21毫秒和0.23焦耳,RT-DETR-R18的则需要59毫秒和0.77焦耳.

blocks.en:
The current RVT-T implementation processes event-count representations with a transformer on the GPU.
Spiking neural networks (SNNs) paired with neuromorphic processors [ 15 ] offer a further direction for reducing energy through sparse, event-driven computation.
blocks.zh:
目前的RVT-T执行过程会用GPU上的变压器进行事件计数表示.
Spiking神经网络(SNNs)与神经形态处理器对齐[15]为通过稀疏的,事件驱动的计算来减少能量提供了进一步的方向.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
This study examines event-based person detection for maritime UAV search using simulated events from annotated MOBDrone footage.
The comparison with frame-based detectors shows a person-detection advantage under synthetic exposure blur, making event sensing a promising option for observing small targets during camera motion.
Video-to-event conversion allows this application to be explored using existing rescue recordings and annotations.
blocks.zh:
这项研究利用附加说明的MOBDrone镜头的模拟事件,审查海上无人驾驶航空器搜索基于事件的个人探测。
与帧式探测器的比较显示,在合成照射模糊的情况下具有人-探测的优势,使事件感知成为摄像头运动时观测小目标的一种有希望的选择.
视频对事件转换可以利用现有的救援录音和说明来探索这个应用程序.

blocks.en:
Separating a person from activity on the water remains central to the monitoring task.
The event representation can retain a compact target response in blurred scenes, while water motion also produces events that compete with the person.
For a search operator, useful detections should draw attention to a possible person without repeatedly flagging the surrounding water.
Following candidate detections over time and combining event observations with conventional imagery are practical directions for improving this distinction.
blocks.zh:
将一个人与水上活动分开仍然是监测任务的核心。
事件表现可以在模糊的场景中保留紧凑的目标响应,而水运动也会产生与人物竞争的事件.
对于搜索操作员来说,有用的检测应提请可能的人注意,而不必反复标注周围的水。
随时间推移进行候选检测,将事件观测与常规图像相结合,是改进这种区分的实际方向。

blocks.en:
A next step is to evaluate synchronized frame and event recordings of people in the water under different sea states, illumination levels, and camera motions.
This would allow the detection performance and false positives observed here to be examined during continuous search sequences, together with the processing demands on the UAV.
blocks.zh:
下一步是评估不同海态下水中人群的同步帧和事件录音,照明水平,以及相机运动.
这将使在此观测到的检测性能和假阳性在连续搜索序列中以及无人驾驶航空器的处理要求得到检查。
